title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Mr. Smith presents today for routine follow-up evaluation.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports feeling generally stable since the last visit. He continues to manage his end stage renal disease with scheduled treatments. He denies any acute symptoms, shortness of breath, or significant changes in appetite. His overall status remains consistent with his known end stage renal disease (ESRD).

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily, Phosphate binder as needed.

Exam
Vitals are stable today. Physical examination reveals no acute distress. Cardiovascular exam is unremarkable. Abdomen is soft and non-tender. Skin is warm and intact.

Assessment
1. End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD): Stable. Patient remains in management for ESRD.

Plan
Continue current medications. Follow up as scheduled for further management of ESRD. Patient educated on monitoring fluid intake at home.
explanations: ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.

distractors.why: Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
